product.name: Morph Apply
product.description: A specialized AI model that applies code changes suggested by frontier AI models to existing code files at over 2000 tokens per second.

product.name: Morph Embeddings
product.description: A code embedding model trained on millions of commits to enable high-precision code search and retrieval.

product.name: Morph Reranking
product.description: A reranking model trained on millions of code examples to prioritize the most relevant code snippets for prompt construction.

product.name: Morph Speculative Edits
product.description: Inference optimizations and speculative decoding techniques to accelerate code edit application.

product.name: Morph Self-Hosting Deployment
product.description: An option to deploy Morph models and services within a company’s own cloud or infrastructure for security and control.
